preconditions.description: The first line is your name (non-empty string), and the second line is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100) representing the number of actions.
Each of the next n lines contains exactly one action in the format 'X posted on Y's wall', 'X commented on Y's post', or 'X likes Y's post', with exactly one space between words.

preconditions.expression: all('s' in line for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:2+n])
preconditions.description: All action lines contain the possessive form 's' (e.g., 'Y's wall', 'Y's post').

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(name) <= 10 for name in re.findall(r'\b[a-z]{1,10}\b', stdin))
preconditions.description: All names in the input consist of 1 to 10 lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output is a newline-separated list of distinct names (excluding your name) sorted by descending priority factor with you. If two names have the same priority factor, they are sorted lexicographically in ascending order.

postconditions.expression: all(name != my_name for name in distinct_names)
postconditions.description: The output excludes your name (the first line of input).

postconditions.expression: all(name in distinct_names for name in set(re.findall(r'\b[a-z]{1,10}\b', stdin)) - {my_name})
postconditions.description: The output includes all distinct names from the input (excluding your name), even if their priority factor is zero.
